thread:
morgan: heads up — after yesterday's kernel selector tweak i see p95 climb on route 'chat-small' (~120ms -> ~210ms). graphs + flame look like more small batches and worse kv cache hit rate :eyes:

ajay: saw that too. perf-alert-bot fired this morning. looks correlated with kernel-switch 2026-03-15T03:42 (selector now prefers fp16-fused kernel).

perf-alert-bot: ALERT: chat-small p95 increased 1.75x over baseline. metric: p95_latency_ms. window: 30m. link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/6789

morgan: re-ran a quick profile, attached flame — there's an extra ~8ms per-request in kernel setup and batch assembly seems to favor 1-2 request microbatches more often. also kv-cache hit-rate dipped ~6%.

sara: quick numbers from local perf harness (same model, same seq dist):
```
baseline (kernel v12): p95 118ms, kv-hit 87%, avg batch size 5.6
fp16-fused (kernel v13): p95 209ms, kv-hit 81%, avg batch size 3.1
```
looks like kernel v13 has higher per-batch setup time so batch formation is shorter-lived.

ajay: ok — two levers here: 1) adjust kernel selector fallback (prefer kernel v12 for chat-small) or 2) change per-route token-budget target / queue policy so batcher waits to form larger batches despite kernel overhead.

carla: we should prefer config change over rolling back kernel globally. can we do a route-scoped token-budget tweak and canary it? goal: restore p95 under 140ms for chat-small.

sara: i ran microbenchmarks on token budgets. rough rule: increasing target_token_budget from 256->480 increases avg batch size ~1.8x and reduces overhead per token; example config snippet i used:
```
route_overrides:
  chat-small:
    policy: DELAYED_WAIT
    target_token_budget: 480
    max_wait_ms: 15
    min_batch_size: 2
```
with that on the harness p95 moved to ~132ms (model kernel v13). kv-hit unchanged (that's separate).

ajay: DELAYED_WAIT is our queue policy that biases small-latency routes to wait a bit longer before dispatching. note that it can increase tail if traffic is extremely bursty. we should add a tier-based switch: for paid-tier routes keep conservative wait, for free-tier keep aggressive low-latency.

morgan: would like to try two things in canary: a) route override with target_token_budget=480 + DELAYED_WAIT for chat-small; b) enable a kernel affinity override to prefer v12 for 10% of traffic to compare. can we scope to a single deployment group?

devops-bot: deploy request received — canary env: canary-east-03. to proceed, include config diff and canary percentage. (see runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/canary-batch-tuning)

ajay: config diff i'll push to canary:
```
- default_batcher:
-  target_token_budget: 256
+ route_overrides:
+  chat-small:
+    target_token_budget: 480
+    queue_policy: DELAYED_WAIT
+    kernel_affinity: prefer-v12(10%)
```
also adding extra metrics: batch_size_hist, kernel_setup_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate by route.

carla: include an eval set (prompt_set id 239) for quality/regression check. we don't want subtle generation changes if kernel differs.

sara: i'll run a side-by-side harness for the eval set and post token-level latency & perf deltas in ~30m. if p95 < 140ms and no quality regression, we flip to 100% for chat-small.

morgan: thanks — please @ajay @sara when you push canary and when the harness is done. i'm going to notify CS that we might run a short canary window to avoid customer impact. :thumbsup:
